datasets.name: sales_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  order_date,
  total_orders,
  total_revenue,
  avg_order_value,
  unique_customers,
  dine_in_orders,
  takeaway_orders,
  delivery_orders
FROM
  wx_dbxproject.`03_gold`.d_sales_summary
WHERE
  (
    :date_range.min IS NULL
    OR order_date >= :date_range.min
  )
  AND (
    :date_range.max IS NULL
    OR order_date <= :date_range.max
  )
ORDER BY
  order_date

datasets.name: review_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  restaurant_id,
  restaurant_name,
  city,
  total_reviews,
  avg_rating,
  rating_5_count,
  rating_4_count,
  rating_3_count,
  rating_2_count,
  rating_1_count,
  sentiment_positive_count,
  sentiment_neutral_count,
  sentiment_negative_count
FROM
  d_restaurant_reviews
WHERE
  (
    :restaurant_name IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:restaurant_name, restaurant_name)

datasets.name: review_details
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.review_id,
  r.restaurant_id,
  rst.name AS restaurant_name,
  rst.city,
  r.rating,
  r.review_text,
  r.sentiment,
  r.issue_delivery,
  r.issue_food_quality,
  r.issue_pricing,
  r.issue_portion_size,
  r.review_timestamp,
  CAST(r.review_timestamp AS DATE) AS review_date
FROM
  fact_reviews r
    LEFT JOIN dim_restaurants rst
      ON r.restaurant_id = rst.restaurant_id
WHERE
  (
    :restaurant_name IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:restaurant_name, rst.name)

datasets.name: issue_categorization
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Delivery' AS issue_category,
  COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM
  fact_reviews r
    LEFT JOIN dim_restaurants rst
      ON r.restaurant_id = rst.restaurant_id
WHERE
  LOWER(r.issue_delivery) = 'true'
  AND (
    :restaurant_name IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:restaurant_name, rst.name)
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Food Quality',
  COUNT(*)
FROM
  fact_reviews r
    LEFT JOIN dim_restaurants rst
      ON r.restaurant_id = rst.restaurant_id
WHERE
  LOWER(r.issue_food_quality) = 'true'
  AND (
    :restaurant_name IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:restaurant_name, rst.name)
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Pricing',
  COUNT(*)
FROM
  fact_reviews r
    LEFT JOIN dim_restaurants rst
      ON r.restaurant_id = rst.restaurant_id
WHERE
  LOWER(r.issue_pricing) = 'true'
  AND (
    :restaurant_name IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:restaurant_name, rst.name)
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Portion Size',
  COUNT(*)
FROM
  fact_reviews r
    LEFT JOIN dim_restaurants rst
      ON r.restaurant_id = rst.restaurant_id
WHERE
  LOWER(r.issue_portion_size) = 'true'
  AND (
    :restaurant_name IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:restaurant_name, rst.name)

datasets.name: recent_reviews
queryLines:
SELECT
  rst.name AS restaurant_name,
  r.review_text,
  r.sentiment,
  r.rating,
  r.review_timestamp
FROM
  fact_reviews r
    LEFT JOIN dim_restaurants rst
      ON r.restaurant_id = rst.restaurant_id
WHERE
  r.sentiment IN ('positive', 'negative')
  AND (
    :restaurant_name IS NULL
    OR array_contains(:restaurant_name, rst.name)
  )
ORDER BY
  r.review_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: restaurant_list
queryLines:

FROM

ORDER BY
